newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to soak up 500 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to soak up 500 bln won through repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Wednesday it would offer 500 billion won in repurchase agreements (repos) to commercial banks to soak up liquidity in the banking system.
A central bank official said the bank would siphon off money in circulation until July 22, starting from Wednesday.
Bond dealers said the intervention might affect the overnight call rate, which briefly fell to the 10 percent level.
